fact_text: The Pakistan Stock Exchange settlement cycle moves from T+2 to T+1 from Monday 9 February 2026, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: Under T+2 a trade made on Monday settles on Wednesday; under T+1 the same trade settles on Tuesday, one trading day sooner.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: On settlement, a buyer's shares are credited to the buyer's account and a seller's sale proceeds are credited to the seller's account.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: The SECP is the apex regulator that oversaw and guided the T+1 change across the exchange, the clearing company, the depository and the market institutions.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: The Central Depository Company is the sole custodian holding shares in electronic form and handles share movements, while the National Clearing Company clears trades and the money flows.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: Brokerage houses, custodian banks and mutual fund management companies are the main market participants that must adjust to a shorter settlement cycle.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: Brokers and their clients post cash and securities margins against settlement risk, and those margins are released once a trade settles, so a shorter cycle frees them sooner.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: Under T+1, sale proceeds reach an investor one day after the sale instead of two days, so the cash can be redeployed sooner.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: The interviewee expects the faster cycle to lower settlement risk and to give better results over the longer term once participants become familiar with it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: Banking channels and foreign exchange transactions must also speed up for the shorter cycle to work smoothly, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: The interviewee said Shariah scholars' consensus is that a share may be sold only after it is credited to the investor's account, so a one-day cycle shortens that wait.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: More than 50% of companies listed on the PSX are Shariah compliant, and they make up more than 50% of market capitalisation, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: Shariah-compliant instruments account for about 60 to 70% of PSX trading volume, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: Sukuk trade on average about 4 to 5 billion a day, the interviewee said, after a slow start when sukuk had little liquidity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: Overall PSX trading volume has risen several-fold over 2024 to 2026, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: Cash-settled futures were launched, faced an early adjustment period, and then became very popular, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: About 80% of new brokerage accounts are now opened through online channels, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: Over 50% of new accounts come from cities outside Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad, a shift the interviewee has seen over 2024 to 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: The CDC's Asaan Connect platform lets investors open accounts in several asset classes digitally, without first visiting a broker.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: More than 200 licensed brokers operate across Pakistan, spread over the whole country, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: A new trading system implemented in 2023 has processed the higher trading volumes seamlessly, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: The interviewee said the market may need time to adjust liquidity after T+1, and expects better outcomes over the long run as participants understand the change.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)

fact_text: The interviewee said India was reported to be moving quickly toward T+0 settlement, which the exchange may consider later as another variant.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Need To Know About PSX's New Settlement Cycle | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-02)
